title: DIY Vertical Herb Garden Project
reason: Explains the step-by-step process of creating a vertical herb garden.

tasks.task: Describe the initial setup needed for a vertical garden.

subtasks.text: Measure and mark the spots for attaching small pots on a reclaimed wood plank.
Drill holes at the marked spots for securing the pots.

tasks.task: Detail the installation of the small pots.

subtasks.text: Screw small pots into the drilled holes to ensure they are secure.
Attach hooks or brackets to the top of the plank for hanging the garden.

tasks.task: Describe the final steps to complete the vertical garden.

subtasks.text: Fill the pots with soil and plant your chosen herbs.
Water the plants and place the garden in a sunny location.
